# Fathur Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Agus Fathurrahman Rifai (Fathur), an IT student at Universitas Brawijaya specializing in UI/UX Design and Frontend Development.

This is a single-page personal portfolio built with React, GSAP, and Tailwind CSS. It showcases web development projects, graphic/apparel design work, professional experience, and skills in React, Figma, GSAP, Tailwind CSS, Next.js, and TypeScript.

## Sections

- About: background and introduction
- Skills: technical and design tools
- Experience: work and community involvement (Provoks Multimedia, PKKMB, internships)
- Projects: web development and graphic design portfolio pieces
- Contact: email, phone, and social links
